definitions.explanation: An abnormally high body temperature, typically 38°C (100.4°F) or above. Used in medical and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{高熱|こうねつ}を{出|だ}して{学校|がっこう}を{休|やす}んだ。
examples.english: The child had a high fever and stayed home from school.

examples.japanese: {三日間|みっかかん}{高熱|こうねつ}が{続|つづ}いたので、{病院|びょういん}で{検査|けんさ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: The high fever persisted for three days, so I had tests done at the hospital.

notes:
Compound of {高|こう} (high) + {熱|ねつ} (fever/heat).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高熱|こうねつ}が{出|で}る (develop a high fever)
- {高熱|こうねつ}を{出|だ}す (run a high fever)
- {高熱|こうねつ}が{続|つづ}く (a high fever persists)
- {高熱|こうねつ}が{下|さ}がる (a high fever comes down)

Distinct from {微熱|びねつ} (slight fever, around 37-37.5°C) and {発熱|はつねつ} (fever in general). {高熱|こうねつ} specifically implies a temperature high enough to cause concern.
